what: Each Monday COP locks one direction word per place. A word held if the layers that moved still passed COP's move test the following week, against the same baseline that earned the word.
not_a_forecast: A direction word says which measurements moved against their own recent normal. It is not a warning or a forecast and carries no probability, so this record is kept apart from the Brier score.

rising.label: Rising

reference.basis: Steady places where two or more layers moved this way the following week

rising.skill_withheld: Skill is held until a word has 30 independently scored calls, a shared press series counting once.

edging_up.label: Edging up

reference.basis: The same layers, in place-weeks where they had not moved

edging_up.skill_withheld: Skill is held until a word has 30 independently scored calls, a shared press series counting once.
